question: What should mark a choice the preview picked by itself?
parked: #2271, the gutter button, before its review
shortVersion: When the preview works out how the story reaches the line you're on, it has to pick an option at every choice you haven't pinned. The script's left edge shows a small mark on each option it picked. This asks what the mark should be, or whether there should be one at all.

background.alt: Phone screenshot of the script with a bulleted-list icon in the left edge

background:
- **The route.** The thin coloured strip down the left edge is the path the preview took.
- **The mark.** The option the preview took gets a mark.

options.name: Keep the bulleted-list icon

pictures.alt: A filled pin on the first option and a bulleted-list icon on the second

options.pros: already built, and a different shape from a pin.
options.cons: reads as "a menu", not "the preview chose this".

options.name: A hollow pin

pictures.alt: A filled pin on the first option and an outlined pin on the second
Route list with an outlined pin on the Auto row

options.pros: one shape in two states, like an empty and a ticked box.
options.cons: an outline could be read as "pinned but switched off".
options.undo: swap one icon in one component

options.name: A small dot on the strip

pictures.alt: A filled pin on the first option and a small dot on the second

options.cons: nothing says you can press it to pin.
options.undo: swap one icon in one component.

options.name: A branching-arrow icon

pictures.alt: A filled pin on the first option and a branching arrow on the second

options.example: The arrow is the one the route list already uses for a detour.
options.pros: accurate: a fork was taken here.
options.cons: a third icon family beside the pin and the detour arrow.
options.undo: swap one icon in one component.

options.name: No mark, the strip alone

pictures.alt: A filled pin on the first option and no mark on the second

options.pros: only pins and breakpoints in the left edge.
options.cons: you could no longer pin a choice from the script line.
options.undo: restore the mark and its pop-up, about a day of work.

comparison:
| Option | Says the preview chose | Shows you can pin | No new icon |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | No | No | Yes |
| **B** | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| C | Partly | No | Yes |
| D | Yes | No | No |
| E | No | No | Yes |

recommendation.reason: It is the only option that explains itself and needs no new icon.
